messages:
Sana (AE): Hey team — Helix Health is ready to move forward with a POC but they need a small compliance bundle: SOC 2 excerpt (scope + date), ISO 27001 screenshot, a signed pen-test attestation (not the raw report), and a short control map that ties our controls to HIPAA ePHI categories. They also want a short note on Hosted vs Dedicated POC pricing and any minimum commit. Can we produce a single ZIP for their contract dataroom by EOD tomorrow?
Derek (SE): I can extract the SOC 2 excerpt and write a 2-paragraph control summary focused on auth, encryption, logging/retention. Will include effective date and auditor firm.
Olga (Security): Ill prepare the attestation template and an executive summary of the latest external pen-test (date, in-scope assets, high/medium findings, remediation status). Confirming: Helix only wants attestation + exec summary, not raw findings, correct?
Sana (AE): Correct — they explicitly asked for attestation + exec summary. No raw report unless contractually required.
Olga (Security): OK. Ill also add a brief statement about KMS segregation and ephemeral staging creds, plus a short staging-scan policy (48h notice, 3h authenticated window, scheduling alias). Need Legal to confirm signer for the attestation. @Renee can you sign?
Renee (Legal): I can sign the attestation as Head of Legal. Please don't commit to operational changes in the language; route any redlines back to Legal. I can review small edits same day, bigger changes may take up to 48h.
Timo (SRE): I will generate a sanitized network/dataflow diagram and a hosting manifest (region, tenancy type, storage controls). I will remove IPs/hostnames. For delivery we can either upload to the dataroom or provide a presigned S3 link. Presign example (7 days):
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/helix-poc-compliance.zip --expires-in 604800
```
Sana (AE): Helix prefers dataroom upload but will accept S3 presigned if needed. For Dedicated POC, what's the minimum reservation?
Derek (SE): Dedicated requires a short reserved slot — typically 2–3 weeks for isolated capacity plus a one-time onboard fee. Hosted is pay-as-you-go with no reservation but could be costlier under sustained load. Ill draft a one-row pricing comparison (low/medium/high usage).
Olga (Security): Note for README: we will not share raw pentest artifacts without NDA + explicit approval. Provide exec summary + remediation status only. Ill include that as a line in the README.
TicketBot: Ticket #POC-9912 created: "Helix POC compliance bundle" assigned to Olga, Derek, Timo. Due: 2026-01-17.
Sana (AE): Action items: Olga -> attestation + exec summary + staging scan policy; Renee -> signer confirmation; Timo -> sanitized diagram + manifest; Derek -> SOC2 excerpt + pricing comparison + one-slide summary. Target single ZIP upload by 16:00 PT tomorrow.
Olga (Security): Ill post draft attestation in the ticket by 10:00 PT tomorrow.
Renee (Legal): Pre-approving signer text now; will sign final attestation once posted.
Timo (SRE): Diagram + manifest ETA: tomorrow 12:30 PT, will attach presign command if dataroom access is delayed.
Derek (SE): SOC 2 excerpt + pricing table ETA: tomorrow 15:00 PT.
Sana (AE): Great — Ill confirm NDA/dataroom access with Helix and update the ticket. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
